headline: Microsoft describes Project Perception as a control system for internal AI agents
summary: In an Oct 19 post, Microsoft Security EVP Hayete Gallot argues that enterprise AI agents should be treated as “agentic insiders” and says Project Perception can be applied to monitor and govern them. The post describes assigning agents identities, containers and permissions; estimating risk from signals; and using Guardian Agents to supervise and respond to actions. This is Microsoft’s account of an intended security approach and stated availability, not evidence of measured efficacy, broad deployment or independent validation.
